title: Glean Pricing in 2026: Cost, Seats, and Minimums
summary: Glean pricing lacks published rates and uses per-person usage allowances plus credits billed for overage. Plan your overage budget beyond seat counts.
body_markdown:
## Hidden Costs and Limits Glean Buyers Hit


Before you sign, price three things that sit outside the headline price: a seat minimum, metered query usage and paid setup work. Glean hasn't confirmed several of the figures below, so each is flagged where it appears.


### Seat minimums and contract length


Watch for the 100-seat minimum that reports mention; Glean hasn't confirmed it. Glean's documentation does confirm the Thinking Mode cap of 100 queries per user per week, with excess usage consuming FlexCredits at the current rate card.


I don't have a confirmed amount for Premium Support, which carries an annual fee. Implementation runs $8,400 to $20,000, unconfirmed, so you can't finalize budget lines. Glean hasn't confirmed the 275+ connectors either.


Per[Exploreagentic](https://www.exploreagentic.ai/insights/glean-100-seat-minimum/) , if the 100-seat minimum holds, a 15-person team **pays for 85 seats nobody sits in** , meaning they subsidize a pricing model built for much larger organizations. That one line can outweigh every discount you negotiate.


I also don't have a confirmed contract length, so ask for it in writing, along with what happens if you shrink at renewal.


### Usage caps and add-ons


Pick a mode and you pick the burn rate: Glean meters assistant queries in FlexCredits. Per[Glean's Flex pricing documentation](https://docs.glean.com/glean-enterprise-flex-pricing) , a Fast mode Assistant query costs 0 FlexCredits (unlimited), so quick lookups are free.


Step up to a standard Thinking query and it costs 7 to 26, Adaptive standard costs 11 to 38, and **Thinking premium costs 35 to 120** . At the top of each range, a premium query uses eight times the credits of a Fast one.


### What deep mode does to your allowance


If your team defaults to the deepest mode for everyday questions, you'll run through your allowance several times faster than the sticker price suggests.


Over a five-day week, the weekly Thinking Mode cap of 100 per user works out to about 20 a day. Anything past it bills as FlexCredit overage. Premium Support is a separate annual fee on top.


### Glean Implementation Cost and Connector Setup Effort


At $8,400 to $20,000, unconfirmed, implementation is a one-time cost. Spread over a year, it can add as much per seat as a small plan upgrade would.


275+ connectors sound generous, but a count doesn't tell you whether the three tools your team lives in are among them. Before you sign, list those tools and ask Glean to show each one connected, not just named on a slide.
